narr: A line of storms moved through the northwest Panhandles during the evening of August 9th. These brought wind damage to portions of the northwest Texas Panhandle during the evening. Rain lingered into the morning of August 10th, where flash flooding occurred in Amarillo.
ev: Interstate 40 under the Bell Street bridge was flooded. This resulted in portions of the highway closed in both directions and water rescues also occurred at multiple underpasses.
lsr: Reports of interstate 40 underneath the Bell Street bridge being flooded with cars stranded.
I-40 at Bell street is flooded out and APD has that portion of the highway closed in both directions; water rescues are ongoing at multiple underpasses.
